d: Franz Wagner put on a SHOW against the Brooklyn Nets, dropping 35 points, 5 rebounds, and 7 assists to lead the Orlando Magic to a thrilling 113-111 victory! With this performance, Franz recorded his 16th career game with at least 30 points, 5 rebounds, and 5 assists as a member of the Magic, passing Penny Hardaway (15) for the third-most such games in franchise history. Only Tracy McGrady (66) and Paolo Banchero (26) have more. The Magic also improved to 7-8 overall and 3-0 in NBA Cup group play, while the Nets fell to 3-12 overall and 0-2 in group play.
